9. The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 seeking to challenge the Award dated 26.07.2024 passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT, South District, Saket Court, Delhi [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"].

sentences.text:
By the Impugned Award,
a compensation in the sum of Rs. 13,23,021 along with 9% interest has been awarded to the Respondent No. 1/Claimant.

10. Learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the Appellant submits that the principle ground for their challenge is that although the injured suffered from 63% disability of his lower right limb, the compensation that has been awarded for his disability was Rs. 8 lakhs.

10.1 Learned Counsel for the Appellant further submits that the learned Tribunal relied on the judgment of the Supreme Court in Master Mallikarjun v. Divisional Manager, National Insurance Co. Ltd; (2014) 14 SCC 396 wherein in para 12, it is stated that where there is a disability up to 90%,
the compensation awarded should be Rs. 5 lakhs.
